translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year, the river breached at the Wangchu bund in Chanzhou — thirty paces in width.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year the river broke at Chanzhou's Wangchu bund — thirty paces wide.

sentences.zh: 八年，始詔河北轉運司計塞河之備，良山令陳曜請疏鄆、滑界糜丘河以分水勢，遂遣使行視遙堤。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict first ordered the Hebei transport commission to plan preparations for blocking the river; Liangshan magistrate Chen Yao requested dredging the Miqiu River on the Yun-Hua border to divide the water's force, and envoys were then dispatched to survey distant dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year an edict ordered the Hebei transport commission to plan flood defenses. Liangshan magistrate Chen Yao proposed dredging the Miqiu River on the Yun-Hua border to split the current, and envoys were sent to survey outer dikes.

sentences.zh: 明道二年，徙大名之朝城縣于杜婆村，廢鄆州之王橋渡、淄州之臨河鎮以避水。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingdao, Chaocheng County of Daming was moved to Dupocun; Yunzhou's Wangqiao crossing and Zizhou's Linhe town were abolished to avoid the waters.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingdao 2 (1033) Daming's Chaocheng County was relocated to Dupocun; Yunzhou's Wangqiao crossing and Zizhou's Linhe town were abandoned to escape the floods.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年七月，河決澶州橫隴埽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Jingyou, the river breached at the Henglong bund in Chanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Jingyou 1 (1034) the river broke at Chanzhou's Henglong bund.

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年，詔權停修決河。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingli, an edict provisionally halted repair of breached rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 1 (1041) an edict temporarily halted breach repairs.

sentences.zh: 自此久不復塞，而議開分水河以殺其暴。

translations.literal: From this time it long went unblocked, while debate turned to opening diversion channels to reduce its violence.
translations.idiomatic: The breach long went unrepaired while debate turned to opening diversion channels to tame the current.

sentences.zh: 未興工而河流自分，有司以聞，遣使特祠之。

translations.literal: Before work began the river divided itself; officials reported it, and envoys were dispatched to offer special sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Before work could begin the river divided on its own. Officials reported it and envoys were sent to offer special sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 三月，命築堤於澶以扞城。

translations.literal: In the third month, dikes were ordered built at Chan to defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month dikes were ordered built at Chan to protect the city.

sentences.zh: 八年六月癸酉，河決商胡埽，決口廣五百五十七步，乃命使行視河堤。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the sixth month of the eighth year, the river breached at the Shanghu bund — the opening five hundred fifty-seven paces wide — and envoys were ordered to survey the river dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the sixth month of the eighth year the river broke at the Shanghu bund — five hundred fifty-seven paces wide — and envoys were sent to survey the dikes.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年三月，河合永濟渠注乾寧軍。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Huangyou, the river joined the Yongji Canal and poured into Ganning Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Huangyou 1 (1049) the river joined the Yongji Canal and poured into Ganning Army.

sentences.zh: 二年七月辛酉，河復決大名府館陶縣之郭固。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the seventh month of the second year, the river again breached at Guogu in Guantao County, Daming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the seventh month of the second year the river broke again at Guogu in Daming's Guantao County.

sentences.zh: 四年正月乙酉，塞郭固而河勢猶壅，議者請開六塔以披其勢。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the first month of the fourth year, Guogu was blocked but the river's force remained congested; counselors requested opening Liuta to split its momentum.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the first month of the fourth year Guogu was sealed but the river remained congested. Advisers proposed opening Liuta to relieve the pressure.

sentences.zh: 至和元年，遣使行度故道，且詣銅城鎮海口，約古道高下之勢。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe, envoys were dispatched to survey the old channel and also proceed to the sea mouth at Tongcheng town to gauge the old course's relative heights.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 1 (1054) envoys were sent to survey the old channel and measure elevations at Tongcheng town's sea mouth against the ancient course.

sentences.zh: 二年，翰林學士歐陽修奏疏曰：

translations.literal: In the second year, Hanlin academician Ouyang Xiu submitted a memorial stating:
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Hanlin academician Ouyang Xiu memorialized:

sentences.zh: 朝廷欲俟秋興大役，塞商胡，開橫隴，回大河于古道。

translations.literal: The court wishes to wait until autumn to undertake a great project — block Shanghu, open Henglong, and return the great river to the old channel.
translations.idiomatic: The court plans to wait until autumn for a major project — seal Shanghu, open Henglong, and return the great river to its old course.

sentences.zh: 夫動大眾必順天時、量人力，謀於其始而審於其終，然後必行，計其所利者多，乃可無悔。

translations.literal: To mobilize the masses one must comply with heaven's seasons and measure human strength, plan at the beginning and examine at the end — only then must one proceed; reckon where benefits are many, and then one may be without regret.
translations.idiomatic: Mobilizing the masses requires matching heaven's seasons and measuring human capacity — planning from the start and examining the end. Only then should work proceed, and only where benefits clearly outweigh costs will there be no regret.

sentences.zh: 比年以來，興役動眾，勞民費財，不精謀慮于厥初，輕信利害之偏說，舉事之始，既已蒼皇，群議一搖，尋復悔罷。

translations.literal: In recent years, launching projects and mobilizing masses has taxed the people and wasted wealth, without careful planning at the outset, lightly trusting partial arguments of advantage and harm — at the project's beginning already flustered, once assembled opinion wavers, soon regretting and abandoning.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years projects have taxed the people and wasted treasure because planning at the outset was careless and partial arguments were trusted too easily. Work began in haste; when opinion wavered, projects were abandoned in regret.

sentences.zh: 不敢遠引他事，且如河決商胡，是時執政之臣，不慎計慮，遽謀修塞。

translations.literal: I dare not cite distant examples — take only the breach at Shanghu: at that time the ministers in power, without careful planning, hastily proposed blocking and repair.
translations.idiomatic: I need not cite distant examples — consider only the Shanghu breach. The ministers in power, without careful planning, hastily proposed to seal it.

sentences.zh: 凡科配梢芟一千八百萬，騷動六路一百餘軍州，官吏催驅，急若星火，民庶愁苦，盈於道途。

translations.literal: In all, eighteen million units of shao and jian were levied, disturbing more than a hundred prefectures and armies across six circuits; officials pressed and drove, urgent as sparks and fire; the people's suffering filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen million units of materials were levied across six circuits and more than a hundred prefectures and armies. Officials drove the work with fire-like urgency, and the people's suffering filled every road.

sentences.zh: 或物已輸官，或人方在路，未及興役，尋已罷修，虛費民財，為國斂怨，舉事輕脫，為害若斯。

translations.literal: Sometimes materials had already been delivered to the authorities, sometimes people were still on the road — before labor could be mobilized, the repairs were soon halted; the people's wealth was wasted in vain, the state accumulated resentment, undertakings were launched lightly and abandoned — the harm was such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes materials had already been delivered to the government, sometimes laborers were still on the road — and before work could even begin, the project was called off. Public funds were wasted, popular resentment mounted, and schemes were launched and dropped on a whim. The damage was exactly like this.

sentences.zh: 今又聞復有修河之役，三十萬人之眾，開一千餘里之長河，計其所用物力，數倍往年。

translations.literal: Now I further hear that there will again be a river-repair labor — a force of three hundred thousand men to open a long river of more than a thousand li; estimating the material resources required, several times those of former years.
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear that another river-repair project is planned — three hundred thousand men to open a channel more than a thousand li long, requiring several times the material resources of past years.

sentences.zh: 當此天災歲旱、民困國貧之際，不量人力，不順天時，知其有大不可者五：

translations.literal: At this time of heavenly disaster and yearly drought, when the people are distressed and the state impoverished, without measuring human strength and without following the season — I know there are five great reasons why this must not be done:
translations.idiomatic: At a moment of drought and natural calamity, when the people are exhausted and the treasury empty, this project ignores human capacity and flouts the season. I see five compelling reasons why it must not proceed:

sentences.zh: 蓋自去秋至春半，天下苦旱，京東尤甚，河北次之。

translations.literal: For from last autumn to mid-spring, the empire suffered drought; Jingdong was especially severe, Hebei next.
translations.idiomatic: From last autumn through mid-spring the whole empire has endured drought — Jingdong worst of all, Hebei close behind.

sentences.zh: 國家常務安靜振恤之，猶恐民起為盜，況于兩路聚大眾、興大役乎？

translations.literal: The state constantly attends to tranquility and relief, yet still fears the people rising as bandits — how much less when gathering a great multitude and undertaking a great labor in these two circuits?
translations.idiomatic: The court is already struggling merely to keep the peace and provide relief, and still fears that people will turn to banditry — how much worse if both circuits must mobilize vast numbers for a massive public works project?

sentences.zh: 此其必不可者一也。

translations.literal: This is the first of the reasons why it absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first reason the project must be rejected.

sentences.zh: 河北自恩州用兵之後，繼以凶年，人戶流亡，十失八九。

translations.literal: Hebei, since the military campaign at En Prefecture, was followed by famine years; households fled — eight or nine out of ten were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Since the En Prefecture campaign, Hebei has suffered famine after famine; eight or nine households out of every ten have fled.

sentences.zh: 數年以來，人稍歸復，然死亡之餘，所存者幾，瘡痍未斂，物力未完。

translations.literal: In the years since, people have gradually returned, yet of those who remained after death, how few survive; the wounds are not yet healed, material resources not yet restored.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years some people have drifted back, but survivors are few, wounds from the losses remain unhealed, and the region's resources are still depleted.

sentences.zh: 又京東自去冬無雨雪，麥不生苗，將逾暮春，粟未布種，農心焦勞，所向無望。

translations.literal: Moreover in Jingdong since last winter there has been no rain or snow; wheat has not sprouted; late spring is nearly past and millet not yet sown; farmers' hearts are anxious with toil, with no hope anywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong has had no rain or snow since last winter. Wheat never sprouted; late spring is almost gone and millet still unplanted. Farmers are desperate and see no hope anywhere.

sentences.zh: 若別路差夫，又遠者難為赴役；

translations.literal: If corvée laborers are drafted from other circuits, those far away will find it hard to report for service;
translations.idiomatic: If labor is levied from other circuits, men from distant prefectures will struggle to arrive for duty;

sentences.zh: 一出諸路，則兩路力所不任。

translations.literal: Once labor is drawn from all circuits, the two circuits cannot bear the burden alone.
translations.idiomatic: And if draftees must come from every circuit, Jingdong and Hebei together cannot bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 此其必不可者二也。

translations.literal: This is the second of the reasons why it absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: This is the second reason the project must be rejected.

sentences.zh: 往年議塞滑州決河，時公私之力，未若今日之貧虛；

translations.literal: In former years when blocking the breach at Huazhou was discussed, public and private resources were not as depleted and empty as today;
translations.idiomatic: When blocking the Huazhou breach was discussed in past years, public and private resources were not nearly as depleted as they are today;

sentences.zh: 然猶儲積物料，誘率民財，數年之間，始能興役。

translations.literal: Yet still they had to stockpile materials and induce the people's wealth; only after several years could labor be mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Even then they had to stockpile materials and squeeze the people's wealth for several years before work could begin.

sentences.zh: 今國用方乏，民力方疲，且合商胡塞大決之洪流，此一大役也。

translations.literal: Now the state's revenue is depleted and the people's strength exhausted — and blocking the great torrent of the Shanghu breach is one huge labor.
translations.idiomatic: Now the treasury is empty and the people exhausted, yet blocking the massive Shanghu breach is one enormous undertaking.

sentences.zh: 鑿橫隴開久廢之故道，又一大役也。

translations.literal: Cutting through Henglong to open the long-abandoned old channel is another huge labor.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting through Henglong to reopen the long-abandoned old channel is another enormous undertaking.

sentences.zh: 自橫隴至海千餘里，埽岸久已廢，頓須興緝，又一大役也。

translations.literal: From Henglong to the sea, more than a thousand li — the shao bunds have long been abandoned and would suddenly need comprehensive repair; this too is a huge labor.
translations.idiomatic: From Henglong to the sea — more than a thousand li — the shao bunds have long been abandoned and would need sudden, full-scale repair; yet another enormous undertaking.

sentences.zh: 往年公私有力之時，興一大役，尚須數年，今猝興三大役於災旱貧虛之際。

translations.literal: In former years when public and private resources were strong, launching one huge labor still required several years — now they would suddenly launch three huge labors amid disaster, drought, poverty, and depletion.
translations.idiomatic: In better times, one major project still took years to launch; now they would suddenly undertake three at once amid drought, disaster, and poverty.

sentences.zh: 此其必不可者三也。

translations.literal: This is the third of the reasons why it absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: This is the third reason the project must be rejected.

sentences.zh: 就令商胡可塞，故道未必可開。

translations.literal: Even granting that Shanghu could be blocked, the old channel might not necessarily be opened.
translations.idiomatic: Even if Shanghu could be sealed, the old channel might not be openable at all.

sentences.zh: 鯀障洪水，九年無功，禹得《洪範》五行之書，知水潤下之性，乃因水之流，疏而就下，水患乃息。

translations.literal: Gun blocked the floodwaters for nine years without success; Yu obtained the Hongfan text on the Five Phases, understood water's nature to seek lower ground, and by following the water's flow, dredged and guided it downward — and the flood calamity ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Gun tried to dam the flood for nine years and failed. Yu obtained the Hongfan treatise on the Five Phases, understood that water naturally seeks lower ground, and by guiding the current downward brought the flooding to an end.

sentences.zh: 然則以大禹之功，不能障塞，但能因勢而疏決爾。

translations.literal: Thus even with Yu the Great's achievement, he could not block and dam — he could only follow the terrain and dredge and divert.
translations.idiomatic: Even Yu the Great could not dam and block the river — he could only channel it according to the land's natural contours.

sentences.zh: 今欲逆水之性，障而塞之，奪洪河之正流，使人力斡而回注，此大禹之所不能。

translations.literal: Now they wish to go against water's nature, block and dam it, seize the Great River's main current, and by human force turn and redirect it — this is what even Yu the Great could not do.
translations.idiomatic: Now they propose to defy water's nature — to dam it, seize the Yellow River's main channel, and force it back by human labor. This is what even Yu the Great could not accomplish.

sentences.zh: 此其必不可者四也。

translations.literal: This is the fourth of the reasons why it absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fourth reason the project must be rejected.

sentences.zh: 橫隴湮塞已二十年，商胡決又數歲，故道已平而難鑿，安流已久而難回。

translations.literal: Henglong has been silted and blocked for twenty years; the Shanghu breach has lasted several years; the old channel has already leveled and is hard to cut open, the settled flow has long endured and is hard to turn back.
translations.idiomatic: Henglong has been silted shut for twenty years and the Shanghu breach for several more. The old channel has filled in and would be hard to cut open; the current settled course has held for so long that reversing it would be nearly impossible.

sentences.zh: 此其必不可者五也。

translations.literal: This is the fifth of the reasons why it absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fifth reason the project must be rejected.

sentences.zh: 臣伏思國家累歲災譴甚多，其於京東，變異尤大。

translations.literal: Your subject reflects that the state has suffered many years of heavenly calamity and reproof; in Jingdong the portents have been especially great.
translations.idiomatic: I reflect that the court has endured years of calamity and divine reproof, and that the omens in Jingdong have been especially severe.

sentences.zh: 地貴安靜而有聲，巨嵎山摧，海水搖盪，如此不止者僅十年，天地警戒，宜不虛發。

translations.literal: The earth, which should be tranquil, has had sound; Giant Cliff Mountain collapsed, sea water surged and swayed — such things have not ceased for nearly ten years; heaven and earth's warnings surely are not issued in vain.
translations.idiomatic: The earth, which ought to lie still, has rumbled; Giant Cliff Mountain collapsed and the sea surged — for nearly ten years such signs have not stopped. Warnings from heaven and earth are surely not sent without reason.

sentences.zh: 臣謂變異所起之方，尤當過慮防懼，今乃欲於凶艱之年，聚三十萬之大眾於變異最大之方，臣恐災禍自茲而發也。

translations.literal: Your subject holds that the region where portents arise should especially be treated with excessive caution and fear — yet now they wish in a year of disaster and hardship to gather a great multitude of three hundred thousand in the region of the greatest portents; your subject fears calamity will erupt from this.
translations.idiomatic: The region where these portents have appeared demands the greatest caution — yet now, in a year of disaster, they would gather three hundred thousand men in exactly that region. I fear calamity will erupt from this.

sentences.zh: 況京東赤地千里，饑饉之民，正苦天災。

translations.literal: Moreover Jingdong is barren land for a thousand li; famine-stricken people are already suffering heavenly disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong is a thousand li of scorched earth, and famine-stricken people are already suffering under heaven's wrath.

sentences.zh: 又聞河役將動，往往伐桑毀屋，無復生計。

translations.literal: I further hear that as the river labor is about to begin, people are often cutting mulberry trees and destroying houses, with no livelihood remaining.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that as the river project nears, people are cutting down mulberry trees and tearing down their houses, leaving themselves no way to live.

sentences.zh: 流亡盜賊之患，不可不虞。

translations.literal: The scourge of flight and banditry cannot go unguarded against.
translations.idiomatic: The threat of mass flight and banditry cannot be ignored.

sentences.zh: 宜速止罷，用安人心。

translations.literal: It is fitting to stop and halt it quickly, thereby settling people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The project should be halted immediately to reassure the people.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔：「自商胡之決，大河注金堤，浸為河北患。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict: "Since the Shanghu breach, the Great River has poured toward the Jindi embankment, gradually becoming a calamity for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict declared: "Since the Shanghu breach, the Yellow River has poured toward the Jindi embankment and gradually become a scourge upon Hebei.

sentences.zh: 其故道又以河北、京東饑，故未興役。

translations.literal: Reopening the old channel was further deferred because Hebei and Jingdong were famine-stricken, and so the labor was not undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Reopening the old channel was deferred because Hebei and Jingdong were in famine, and the work was never begun.

sentences.zh: 今河渠司李仲昌議欲納水入六塔河，使歸橫隴舊河，舒一時之急。

translations.literal: Now Li Zhongchang of the River Works Bureau proposes to receive the water into the Liuta River, causing it to return to the Henglong old channel, easing the urgency of the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Now Li Zhongchang of the River Works Bureau proposes diverting water into the Liuta River to send it back toward the Henglong old channel and ease the immediate crisis.

sentences.zh: 其令兩制至待制以上、台諫官，與河渠司同詳定。」

translations.literal: Let Hanlin academicians from dazhi through daizhi rank and censorial remonstrance officials jointly review this in detail together with the River Works Bureau."
translations.idiomatic: Let Hanlin academicians from dazhi through daizhi rank, together with censorial officials and the River Works Bureau, conduct a joint review."

sentences.zh: 修又上疏曰：

translations.literal: Xiu again submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu submitted another memorial, saying:

sentences.zh: 伏見學士院集議修河，未有定論。

translations.literal: Your subject observes that the Hanlin Academy's collective deliberation on river repair has reached no settled conclusion.
translations.idiomatic: I observe that the Hanlin Academy's collective deliberation on river repair has reached no settled conclusion.

sentences.zh: 豈由賈昌朝欲復故道，李仲昌請開六塔，互執一說，莫知孰是。

translations.literal: Is it because Jia Changchao wishes to restore the old channel while Li Zhongchang requests opening Liuta — each holding to one proposal with no way to know which is correct?
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps because Jia Changchao wants to restore the old channel while Li Zhongchang urges opening Liuta — each clinging to one plan with no way to judge which is right.

sentences.zh: 臣愚皆謂不然。

translations.literal: Your subject in his foolishness holds that both are not so.
translations.idiomatic: In my humble view, both are wrong.

sentences.zh: 言故道者，未詳利害之原；

translations.literal: Those who speak of the old channel have not fully understood the root of the costs and benefits;
translations.idiomatic: Those who advocate restoring the old channel have not grasped the root of the costs and benefits;

sentences.zh: 述六塔者，近乎欺罔之繆。

translations.literal: Those who describe Liuta come close to deceitful error.
translations.idiomatic: Those who advocate Liuta come close to outright deception.

sentences.zh: 今謂故道可復者，但見河北水患，而欲還之京東。

translations.literal: Those who now say the old channel can be restored see only Hebei's flood calamity and wish to return it to Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: Those who say the old channel can be restored see Hebei's flooding and want to send the river back to Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 然不思天禧以來河水屢決之因，所以未知故道有不可復之勢，臣故謂未詳利害之原也。

translations.literal: Yet they do not consider the reasons the river has repeatedly breached since the Tianxi era — hence they do not know that the old channel has an irreversible tendency; your subject therefore says they have not fully understood the root of the costs and benefits.
translations.idiomatic: They do not consider why the river has breached repeatedly since the Tianxi era, and so fail to see that the old channel cannot be restored — hence I say they have not grasped the root of the matter.

sentences.zh: 若言六塔之利者，則不待攻而自破矣。

translations.literal: If one speaks of Liuta's benefits, the argument collapses of itself without needing refutation.
translations.idiomatic: Claims about Liuta's benefits collapse on their own without needing refutation.

sentences.zh: 今六塔既已開，而恩、冀之患，何為尚告奔騰之急？

translations.literal: Now Liuta has already been opened — yet why do En and Ji prefectures still report urgent surging flood calamity?
translations.idiomatic: Liuta is already open — so why do En and Ji prefectures still report urgent flooding?

sentences.zh: 此則減水未見其利也。

translations.literal: This shows that reducing water has not revealed its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that the touted water reduction has brought no benefit at all.

sentences.zh: 又開六塔者雲，可以全回大河，使復橫隴故道。

translations.literal: Furthermore, those who advocate opening Liuta say it can fully divert the Great River and restore the Henglong old channel.
translations.idiomatic: Advocates of Liuta claim it can fully divert the Yellow River back to the Henglong old channel.

sentences.zh: 今六塔止是別河下流，已為濱、棣、德、博之患，若全回大河，顧其害如何？

translations.literal: Now Liuta is merely a branch of the river's lower reach and already afflicts Bin, Di, De, and Bo prefectures — if the entire Great River were diverted, consider what the harm would be?
translations.idiomatic: Liuta is merely a branch of the lower stream and already harms Bin, Di, De, and Bo — what harm would follow if the entire river were diverted there?

sentences.zh: 此臣故謂近乎欺罔之繆也。

translations.literal: This is why your subject says it comes close to deceitful error.
translations.idiomatic: This is why I call it near-deceitful nonsense.

sentences.zh: 且河本泥沙，無不淤之理。

translations.literal: Moreover the river is inherently muddy and sandy — there is no principle by which it does not silt up.
translations.idiomatic: The river is inherently laden with silt and sand — silting is inevitable.

sentences.zh: 淤常先下流，下流淤高，水行漸壅，乃決上流之低處，此勢之常也。

translations.literal: Siltation usually begins at the lower reach; when the lower reach silts high, the water's flow is gradually choked, and then it breaches at a low point upstream — this is the usual tendency.
translations.idiomatic: Silt accumulates first downstream; as the lower reach rises, flow is gradually choked until the river breaks out at a low point upstream — the usual pattern.

sentences.zh: 然避高就下，水之本性，故河流已棄之道，自古難復。

translations.literal: Yet avoiding the high and seeking the low is water's inherent nature — hence channels the river has already abandoned have from antiquity been hard to restore.
translations.idiomatic: Water naturally seeks lower ground, so channels the river has already abandoned have always been hard to restore.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢廣述河源，且以今所欲復之故道，言天禧以來屢決之因。

translations.literal: Your subject dares not broadly expound the river's source — let him speak only of the old channel they now wish to restore, and explain the reasons for repeated breaches since the Tianxi era.
translations.idiomatic: I will not expound the river's ultimate source; for the channel they wish to restore, I will explain why it has repeatedly breached since the Tianxi era.

sentences.zh: 初，天禧中，河出京東，水行於今所謂故道者。

translations.literal: Initially, in the Tianxi period, the river issued from Jingdong and the water flowed along what is now called the old channel.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianxi period the river flowed east out of Jingdong along what is now called the old channel.

sentences.zh: 水既淤澀，乃決天臺埽，尋塞而復故道；

translations.literal: Once the water had silted and choked, it breached at Tiantai shao; soon it was blocked and returned to the old channel;
translations.idiomatic: After silting choked the channel, it breached at Tiantai shao; the breach was sealed and flow returned to the old channel;

sentences.zh: 未幾，又決于滑州南鐵狗廟，今所謂龍門埽者。

translations.literal: Before long it breached again south of Huazhou at the Iron Dog Temple — what is now called Longmen shao.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it breached again south of Huazhou at the Iron Dog Temple — today's Longmen shao.

sentences.zh: 其後數年，又塞而復故道。

translations.literal: In the years after, it was again blocked and returned to the old channel.
translations.idiomatic: A few years later it was blocked again and flow returned to the old channel.

sentences.zh: 已而又決王楚埽，所決差小，與故道分流，然而故道之水終以壅淤，故又於橫隴大決。

translations.literal: Then it breached again at Wangchu shao — the breach was somewhat smaller and split flow with the old channel — yet the old channel's water ultimately choked and silted up, and so there was a major breach at Henglong.
translations.idiomatic: Then it breached at Wangchu shao — a smaller break that split flow with the old channel — but the old channel still silted up until a major breach opened at Henglong.

sentences.zh: 是則決河非不能力塞，故道非不能力復，所復不久終必決於上流者，由故道淤而水不能行故也。

translations.literal: Thus breaches could be forcibly blocked and the old channel forcibly restored — yet what was restored did not last long and always eventually breached upstream, because the old channel silted and water could not flow.
translations.idiomatic: Breaches could be forcibly sealed and the old channel forcibly restored — but restorations never lasted, because the old channel silted up and water could not pass.

sentences.zh: 及橫隴既決，水流就下，所以十餘年間，河未為患。

translations.literal: Once Henglong had breached, the water flowed to lower ground — hence for more than ten years the river caused no calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Once Henglong breached, water ran downward — and for more than ten years the river caused no harm.

sentences.zh: 至慶曆三、四年，橫隴之水，又自海口先淤，凡一百四十餘里；

translations.literal: By the third and fourth years of Qingli, the Henglong stream silted first from the estuary — in all more than one hundred forty li;
translations.idiomatic: By Qingli years three and four, the Henglong channel silted first from the estuary for more than one hundred forty li;

sentences.zh: 其後游、金、赤三河相次又淤。

translations.literal: Afterward the You, Jin, and Chi rivers in succession silted up again.
translations.idiomatic: After that the You, Jin, and Chi rivers silted up in succession.

sentences.zh: 下流既梗，乃決于上流之商胡口。

translations.literal: Once the lower reach was blocked, it breached at Shanghu upstream.
translations.idiomatic: With the lower reach blocked, the river breached at Shanghu upstream.

sentences.zh: 然則京東、橫隴兩河故道，皆下流淤塞，河水已棄之高地。

translations.literal: Thus the old channels of both the Jingdong and Henglong rivers are silt-blocked lower reaches — high ground the river has already abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Both the Jingdong and Henglong old channels are silt-blocked stretches of high ground the river has long since abandoned.

sentences.zh: 京東故道，屢復屢決，理不可復，不待言而易知也。

translations.literal: The Jingdong old channel was repeatedly restored and repeatedly breached — by principle it cannot be restored; this needs no words and is easy to know.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingdong old channel was restored and breached again and again — obviously it cannot be recovered; that needs no argument.

sentences.zh: 昨議者度京東故道功科，但雲銅城已上乃特高爾，其東比銅城以上則稍低，比商胡已上則實高也。

translations.literal: Yesterday's deliberators estimated the work for the Jingdong old channel and said only above Copper City was especially high; east of there it is somewhat lower than above Copper City, but actually higher than above Shanghu.
translations.idiomatic: Previous planners estimated the Jingdong old channel work and claimed only the stretch above Copper City was especially high; east of Copper City the land is somewhat lower, but still actually higher than the reach above Shanghu.

sentences.zh: 若雲銅城以東地勢鬥下，則當日水流宜決銅城已上，何緣而頓淤橫隴之口，亦何緣而大決也？

translations.literal: If they say the terrain east of Copper City slopes steeply downward, then at that time the water ought to have breached above Copper City — why then did Henglong's mouth suddenly silt up, and why the major breach?
translations.idiomatic: If the land east of Copper City truly slopes steeply down, water should have breached above Copper City — so why did Henglong's mouth suddenly silt up, and why the catastrophic breach?

sentences.zh: 然則兩河故道，既皆不可為，則河北水患何為而可去？

translations.literal: Thus if both old river channels are impossible, then how can Hebei's flood calamity be removed?
translations.idiomatic: If both old channels are impossible, how can Hebei's flooding be relieved?

sentences.zh: 臣聞智者之于事，有所不能必，則較其利害之輕重，擇其害少者而為之，猶愈害多而利少，何況有害而無利，此三者可較而擇也。

translations.literal: Your subject has heard that the wise in affairs, when certainty is impossible, compare the light and heavy of costs and benefits and choose the lesser harm — still better than much harm and little benefit; how much more when there is harm without benefit — among these three options one can compare and choose.
translations.idiomatic: When certainty is impossible, the wise weigh lesser against greater harm — better than much harm for little gain, and especially when there is harm without gain. Among these three options one can choose.

sentences.zh: 又商胡初決之時，欲議修塞，計用梢芟一千八百萬，科配六路一百餘州軍。

translations.literal: Moreover when Shanghu first breached, repair and blocking were discussed; the estimate required eighteen million shao and jian, levied across six circuits and more than a hundred prefectures and armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Shanghu first breached, repair was estimated at eighteen million units of shao and jian, levied across six circuits and more than a hundred prefectures and armies.

sentences.zh: 今欲塞者乃往年之商胡，則必用往年之物數。

translations.literal: What they now wish to block is the same Shanghu of former years — hence they must use the same material quantities of former years.
translations.idiomatic: To seal the same Shanghu breach now would require the same materials as before.

sentences.zh: 至於開鑿故道，張奎所計工費甚大，其後李參減損，猶用三十萬人。

translations.literal: As for cutting open the old channel, Zhang Kui's estimate of labor costs was very great; afterward Li Can reduced it, yet it still required three hundred thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Opening the old channel by Zhang Kui's estimate would cost enormously; even Li Can's reduced plan still required three hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 然欲以五十步之狹，容大河之水，此可笑者，又欲增一夫所開三尺之方，倍為六尺，且闊厚三尺而長六尺，自一倍之功，在於人力，已為勞苦。

translations.literal: Yet they wish to contain the Great River's water in a width of only fifty paces — this is laughable; furthermore they wish to increase what one man excavates from a three-chi square to double it as six chi — three chi wide and thick and six chi long — even doubling the work in human labor is already exhausting toil.
translations.idiomatic: Trying to contain the Yellow River in a channel only fifty paces wide is laughable. They also propose doubling each man's excavation from a three-chi square to six chi wide, three thick, and six long — even doubling the labor is already backbreaking.

sentences.zh: 雲六尺之方，以開方法算之，乃八倍之功，此豈人力之所勝？

translations.literal: They say a six-chi section — calculated by the excavation formula — requires eight times the work; how can human strength overcome this?
translations.idiomatic: By excavation calculation a six-chi section requires eight times the work — far beyond human capacity.

sentences.zh: 是則前功既大而難興，後功雖小而不實。

translations.literal: Thus the first labor is already great and hard to launch; the later labor, though smaller, is not real.
translations.idiomatic: The original plan is too large to launch; the scaled-down version is too small to be workable.

sentences.zh: 大抵塞商胡、開故道，凡二大役，皆困國勞人，所舉如此，而欲開難復屢決已驗之故道，使其虛費，而商胡不可塞，故道不可復，此所謂有害而無利者也。

translations.literal: In general, blocking Shanghu and opening the old channel — two great labors in all — both exhaust the state and weary the people; undertakings such as these, yet wishing to open an old channel hard to restore and repeatedly proven by breaches, causing it to be wasted in vain — while Shanghu cannot be blocked and the old channel cannot be restored — this is what is called harm without benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Blocking Shanghu and opening the old channel are two huge undertakings that exhaust the nation and the people. Trying to reopen a channel repeatedly proven unrecoverable wastes everything while neither goal is achievable — pure harm without benefit.

sentences.zh: 就使幸而暫塞，以紓目前之患，而終於上流必決，如龍門、橫隴之比，此所謂利少而害多也。

translations.literal: Even granting that by good fortune it is temporarily blocked to ease the present calamity, in the end upstream will inevitably breach — as at Longmen and Henglong — this is what is called little benefit and much harm.
translations.idiomatic: Even if temporarily sealed to ease present flooding, upstream breach is inevitable — as at Longmen and Henglong — little benefit for much harm.

sentences.zh: 若六塔者，于大河有減水之名，而無減患之實。

translations.literal: As for Liuta, toward the Great River it has the name of reducing water but not the reality of reducing calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Liuta has the name of reducing water but not the reality of reducing disaster.

sentences.zh: 今下流所散，為患已多，若全回大河以注之，則濱、棣、德、博河北所仰之州，不勝其患，而又故道淤澀，上流必有他決之虞，此直有害而無利耳，是皆智者之不為也。

translations.literal: Now the lower reach's dispersal already causes much calamity — if the entire Great River were turned back and poured in, then Bin, Di, De, and Bo — the prefectures Hebei relies upon — could not bear the calamity; moreover the old channel is silted and choked, and upstream there would surely be fear of other breaches — this is simply harm without benefit; these are all things the wise would not do.
translations.idiomatic: Lower branches already cause much harm. Diverting the full river would overwhelm Bin, Di, De, and Bo — prefectures Hebei depends on — while the silted old channel guarantees upstream breach elsewhere. Pure harm, nothing wise men would undertake.

sentences.zh: 今若因水所在，增治堤防，疏其下流，浚以入海，則可無決溢散漫之虞。

translations.literal: Now if according to where the water lies they increase and repair dikes, clear the lower reach, and dredge it to the sea, then there need be no fear of breach, overflow, and dispersal.
translations.idiomatic: Instead, strengthen dikes where the water runs, clear the lower reach, and dredge it to the sea — then there need be no fear of breach and spill.

sentences.zh: 今河所歷數州之地，誠為患矣；

translations.literal: The lands of the several prefectures the river now traverses are indeed afflicted;
translations.idiomatic: The river's passage through several prefectures is indeed a burden;

sentences.zh: 堤防歲用之夫，誠為勞矣。

translations.literal: The laborers used yearly for dikes are indeed wearied.
translations.idiomatic: Annual dike maintenance labor is indeed exhausting.

sentences.zh: 與其虛費天下之財，虛舉大眾之役，而不能成功，終不免為數州之患，勞歲用之夫，則此所謂害少者，乃智者之所宜擇也。

translations.literal: Rather than vainly wasting the empire's wealth and vainly mobilizing a great multitude's labor yet failing to succeed, ultimately not escaping calamity for several prefectures and toiling the yearly dike laborers — this so-called lesser harm is what the wise ought to choose.
translations.idiomatic: Rather than wasting national wealth and masses on doomed projects that still leave several prefectures suffering, the lesser harm — annual dike labor — is what the wise should choose.

sentences.zh: 大約今河之勢，負三決之虞：復故道，上流必決；

translations.literal: In general the present river's tendency bears three risks of breach: restore the old channel and upstream will inevitably breach;
translations.idiomatic: The river today faces three breach risks: restore the old channel and upstream will breach;

sentences.zh: 開六塔，上流亦決；

translations.literal: open Liuta and upstream will also breach;
translations.idiomatic: open Liuta and upstream will also breach;

sentences.zh: 河之下流，若不浚使入海，則上流亦決。

translations.literal: if the river's lower reach is not dredged to let it reach the sea, then upstream will also breach.
translations.idiomatic: if the lower reach is not dredged to the sea, upstream will breach as well.

sentences.zh: 臣請選知水利之臣，就其下流，求入海路而浚之；

translations.literal: Your subject requests that officials who understand water works be selected to go to the lower reach, seek a route to the sea, and dredge it;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that officials skilled in water works be chosen to find and dredge a route to the sea at the lower reach;

sentences.zh: 不然，下流梗澀，則終虞上決，為患無涯。

translations.literal: Otherwise, with the lower reach blocked and choked, there will forever be fear of upstream breach — calamity without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, with the lower reach blocked, upstream breach is inevitable and the harm boundless.

sentences.zh: 臣非知水者，但以今事可驗者較之耳。

translations.literal: Your subject is not one who understands water — he only compares what present affairs can verify.
translations.idiomatic: I am no hydrologist — I only compare what present evidence shows.

sentences.zh: 願下臣議，裁取其當焉。

translations.literal: Your subject wishes Your Majesty to receive his memorial and judge what is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: I ask Your Majesty to receive my memorial and judge what is fitting.

sentences.zh: 預議官翰林學士承旨孫抃等言：開故道，誠久利，然功大難成；

translations.literal: The pre-deliberation officers — Hanlin academician and chief Sun Bi and others — said: opening the old channel would indeed bring lasting benefit, yet the work is great and hard to complete;
translations.idiomatic: The pre-deliberation officers — chief Hanlin academician Sun Bi and others — said: reopening the old channel would bring lasting benefit, but the work is too great to finish;

sentences.zh: 六塔下流，可導而東去，以紓恩、冀金堤之患。

translations.literal: The Liuta lower reach can be directed eastward to ease the calamity at En and Ji's Jindi embankment.
translations.idiomatic: The Liuta lower reach can be directed eastward to relieve flooding at the En and Ji Jindi embankment.

sentences.zh: 十二月，中書上奏曰：「自商胡決，為大名、恩冀患。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Secretariat submitted a memorial: "Since the Shanghu breach, Daming and En-Ji have suffered calamity.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Secretariat memorialized: "Since the Shanghu breach, Daming and En-Ji have suffered.

sentences.zh: 先議開銅城道，塞商胡，以功大難卒就，緩之，而憂金堤泛溢不能捍也。

translations.literal: Previously opening the Copper City route and blocking Shanghu was discussed — because the work was great and hard to complete quickly, it was deferred — yet there is fear the Jindi embankment will overflow and cannot be held.
translations.idiomatic: Opening the Copper City route and blocking Shanghu was deferred as too difficult to finish quickly, yet we fear the Jindi embankment cannot hold the overflow.

sentences.zh: 願備工費，因六塔水勢入橫隴，宜令河北、京東預完堤埽，上河水所居民田數。

translations.literal: We wish to prepare labor costs and, using Liuta's water force to enter Henglong, order Hebei and Jingdong to complete dikes and shao bunds in advance and count the farmland above where the high water reaches.
translations.idiomatic: We ask to prepare funds to use Liuta's flow into Henglong, and order Hebei and Jingdong to complete dikes and shao bunds in advance and tally farmland above the high-water line.

sentences.zh: 」詔下中書奏，以知澶州事李璋為總管，轉運使周沆權同知潭州，內侍都知鄧保吉為鈐轄，殿中丞李仲昌提舉河渠，內殿承制張懷恩為都監。

translations.literal: The edict approved the Secretariat memorial: Li Zhang, administrator of Chanzhou affairs, as overall supervisor; transport commissioner Zhou Hang as acting co-administrator of Tanzhou; inner attendant director Deng Baoji as coordinator; palace censor Li Zhongchang as supervisor of river works; inner palace commissioner Zhang Huai'en as chief overseer.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved the memorial: Li Zhang, prefect of Chanzhou, as overall supervisor; transport commissioner Zhou Hang as acting co-administrator of Tanzhou; inner attendant Deng Baoji as coordinator; Li Zhongchang supervising river works; Zhang Huai'en as chief overseer.

sentences.zh: 而保吉不行，以內侍押班王從善代之。

translations.literal: But Baoji did not go; inner attendant escort officer Wang Congshan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: But Baoji did not go; inner attendant Wang Congshan replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以龍圖閣直學士施昌言總領其事，提點開封府界縣鎮事蔡挺、勾當河渠事楊緯同修河決。

translations.literal: Dragon Diagram Pavilion academician Shi Changyan was appointed to lead the affair overall; Cai Ting, supervisor of Kaifeng prefectural border counties and towns, and Yang Wei, handler of river works affairs, jointly undertook the river breach repair.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Diagram Pavilion academician Shi Changyan was appointed to lead the project; Cai Ting, overseeing Kaifeng border counties and towns, and Yang Wei, handling river works, jointly managed the river breach repair.

sentences.zh: 修又奏請罷六塔之役，時宰相富弼尤主昌議，疏奏亦不省。

translations.literal: Xiu again memorialized requesting abolition of the Liuta project; at the time Chief Councillor Fu Bi especially championed the prevailing plan, and the memorials submitted were also not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu submitted another memorial asking to halt the Liuta project. Chief Councillor Fu Bi was then the strongest advocate of the plan, and these memorials too went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 五年，河流派別于魏之第六埽，曰二股河，其廣二百尺。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the river branched off at Wei's sixth bund — called the Two-Branch River — two hundred feet wide.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the river split at the sixth bund in Wei prefecture, forming what was called the Two-Branch River, two hundred feet across.

sentences.zh: 自二股河行一百三十里，至魏、恩、德、博之境，曰四界首河。

translations.literal: From the Two-Branch River it ran one hundred thirty li to the borders of Wei, En, De, and Bo — called the Four Border Head River.
translations.idiomatic: The Two-Branch River ran one hundred thirty li to where Wei, En, De, and Bo met, a stretch known as the Four Border Head River.

sentences.zh: 七月，都轉運使韓贄言：「四界首古大河所經，即《溝洫志》所謂'平原、金堤，開通大河，入篤馬河，至海五百餘里'者也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Metropolitan Transport Commissioner Han Zan said: "The Four Border Head is where the ancient Great River passed — namely what the 'Treatise on Ditches and Canals' calls 'Pingyuan, Jindi — opening the Great River, entering the Duma River, more than five hundred li to the sea.'"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Metropolitan Transport Commissioner Han Zan said: "The Four Border Head follows the ancient Great River's course — the route described in the Treatise on Ditches and Canals: 'From Pingyuan and Jindi, opening the Great River into the Duma River, more than five hundred li to the sea.'"

sentences.zh: 自春以丁壯三千浚之，可一月而畢。

translations.literal: Starting from spring, with three thousand able-bodied men to dredge it, it could be completed in one month.
translations.idiomatic: Starting in spring, three thousand laborers could dredge it in a month.

sentences.zh: 支分河流入金、赤河，使其深六尺，為利可必。

translations.literal: Branch off the stream into the Jin and Chi rivers, making them six feet deep — the benefit is certain.
translations.idiomatic: Diverting water into the Jin and Chi rivers and deepening them to six feet would surely bring benefit.

sentences.zh: 商胡決河自魏至於恩冀、乾甯入於海，今二股河自魏、恩東至於德、滄入於海，分而為二，則上流不壅，可以無決溢之患。

translations.literal: The Shanghu breach river runs from Wei to En-Ji and Qianning into the sea; now the Two-Branch River runs from Wei and En eastward to De and Cang into the sea. Split in two, the upper reach will not be blocked and breach-flood calamity can be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanghu breach channel runs from Wei through En-Ji and Qianning to the sea; the Two-Branch River runs from Wei and En east to De and Cang to the sea. With the flow divided in two, the upper reach would no longer choke and the risk of breach and overflow would be removed.

sentences.zh: 」乃上《四界首二股河圖》。

translations.literal: " He then submitted the "Diagram of the Four Border Head and Two-Branch River."
translations.idiomatic: " He then submitted a diagram of the Four Border Head and Two-Branch River.

sentences.zh: 七年七月戊辰，河決大名第五埽。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on the wuchen day of the seventh month, the river breached at Daming's fifth bund.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the wuchen day of the seventh month, the river broke through at the fifth bund in Daming.

sentences.zh: 英宗治平元年，始命都水監浚二股、五股河，以紓恩、冀之患。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Yingzong's Zhiping reign, the Directorate of Waterways was first ordered to dredge the Two-Branch and Five-Branch rivers to relieve the calamity in En and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Yingzong's Zhiping reign, the Directorate of Waterways was ordered to dredge the Two-Branch and Five-Branch rivers to ease flooding in En and Ji.

sentences.zh: 初，都水監言：「商胡堙塞，冀州界河淺，房家、武邑二埽由此潰，慮一旦大決，則甚于商胡之患。

translations.literal: Initially the Directorate of Waterways said: "Shanghu is silted shut; the river in the Jizhou section is shallow, and the Fangjia and Wuyi bunds breached for this reason. We fear that once a major breach occurs, it will be worse than the Shanghu calamity."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Directorate of Waterways had reported: "With Shanghu sealed shut, the river along the Jizhou border is shallow, and the Fangjia and Wuyi bunds failed for that reason. A major breach now could prove worse than the Shanghu disaster."

sentences.zh: 」乃遣判都水監張鞏、戶部副使張燾等行視，遂興工役，卒塞之。

translations.literal: " It then dispatched Vice-Director of Waterways Zhang Gong, Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Bureau Zhang Tao, and others to inspect on site, undertook the works, and finally sealed it.
translations.idiomatic: " It sent Vice-Director Zhang Gong of the Directorate of Waterways, Revenue Vice Commissioner Zhang Tao, and others to inspect the site, launched the project, and finally sealed the breach.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙甯元年六月，河溢恩州烏欄堤，又決冀州棗強埽，北注瀛。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Emperor Shenzong's Xining reign, the river overflowed the Wulan dike in Enzhou and breached the Zaoqiang bund in Jizhou, flowing north into Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Shenzong's first Xining year the river overflowed the Wulan dike in Enzhou and broke the Zaoqiang bund in Jizhou, pouring north into Ying prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月，又溢瀛州樂壽埽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month it overflowed again at the Leshou bund in Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month it overflowed again at the Leshou bund in Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝憂之，顧問近臣司馬光等。

translations.literal: The emperor was troubled and turned to consult his close ministers, including Sima Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply worried, the emperor consulted his close advisers, including Sima Guang.

sentences.zh: 都水監丞李立之請于恩、冀、深、瀛等州，創生堤三百六十七里以御河，而河北都轉運司言：「當用夫八萬三千餘人，役一月成。

translations.literal: Directorate Vice-Director Li Lizhi requested building new dikes three hundred sixty-seven li long in En, Ji, Shen, Ying, and other prefectures to hold back the river, but the Hebei Metropolitan Transport Office said: "It would require more than eighty-three thousand corvee laborers and be finished in one month's service."
translations.idiomatic: Directorate Vice-Director Li Lizhi proposed building three hundred sixty-seven li of new dikes in En, Ji, Shen, Ying, and neighboring prefectures to hold the river back. The Hebei transport office replied that this would take more than eighty-three thousand laborers and a month to complete.

sentences.zh: 今方災傷，願徐之。

translations.literal: Disaster and hardship prevail just now — we wish to proceed more slowly.
translations.idiomatic: The region is still recovering from disaster; we ask that the work be deferred.

sentences.zh: 」都水監丞宋昌言謂：「今二股河門變移，請迎河港進約，簽入河身，以紓四州水患。

translations.literal: " Directorate Vice-Director Song Changyan said: "The Two-Branch River mouth has shifted. We request welcoming the river harbor, advancing the contract, and piercing into the river channel to relieve the water calamity in the four prefectures."
translations.idiomatic: " Directorate Vice-Director Song Changyan argued: "The Two-Branch River mouth has shifted. We should meet the river where it runs, advance the upper contract, and pierce the channel to relieve flooding in the four prefectures."

sentences.zh: 」遂與屯田都監內侍程昉獻議，開二股以導東流。

translations.literal: " He then joined with Agriculture Commissioner and inner attendant Cheng Fang in submitting a proposal to open the Two-Branch channel and guide the eastern flow.
translations.idiomatic: " He and Agriculture Commissioner Cheng Fang, an inner attendant, then submitted a plan to open the Two-Branch channel and steer the river eastward.

sentences.zh: 於是都水監奏：「慶曆八年，商胡北流，於今二十餘年，自澶州下至乾寧軍，創堤千有餘里，公私勞擾。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Directorate of Waterways memorialized: "In the eighth year of Qingli the Shanghu breach flowed north; for more than twenty years now, from Chanzhou down to Qianning Army, more than a thousand li of dikes have been built, exhausting public and private resources alike."
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways then memorialized: "Since the Shanghu breach turned north in Qingli 8, more than twenty years ago, over a thousand li of dikes have been built from Chanzhou to Qianning Army, exhausting both the state and the people."

sentences.zh: 近歲冀州而下，河道梗澀，致上下埽岸屢危。

translations.literal: In recent years below Jizhou the river channel has grown choked and sluggish, causing the upper and lower bund banks to be repeatedly endangered.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the channel below Jizhou has silted up, repeatedly threatening the upper and lower bunds.

sentences.zh: 今棗強抹岸，沖奪故道，雖創新堤，終非久計。

translations.literal: Now Zaoqiang is eroding the bank and seizing the old channel; though new dikes are built, this is ultimately no long-term plan.
translations.idiomatic: Zaoqiang is now eating away the bank and cutting into the old channel; new dikes may help, but they are no lasting solution.

sentences.zh: 願相六塔舊口，並二股河導使東流，徐塞北流。

translations.literal: We wish to survey the Liuta old mouth and, together with the Two-Branch River, guide the flow eastward and gradually block the northern flow.
translations.idiomatic: We propose surveying the old Liuta mouth and using the Two-Branch River to steer the flow east while gradually shutting off the northern channel.

sentences.zh: 」而提舉河渠王亞等謂：「黃、御河帶北行入獨流東砦，經乾寧軍、滄州等八砦邊界，直入大海。

translations.literal: " But River Works Supervisor Wang Ya and others said: "The Yellow and Imperial rivers run north into Duliu East Fortress, pass through the border of Qianning Army, Cangzhou, and seven other fortresses, and enter the sea directly."
translations.idiomatic: " But River Works Supervisor Wang Ya and others objected: "The Yellow and Imperial rivers run north into Duliu East Fortress, cross the borders of Qianning Army, Cangzhou, and seven other fortresses, and pour straight into the sea."

sentences.zh: 其近海口闊六七百步，深八九丈，三女砦以西闊三四百步，深五六丈。

translations.literal: Near the estuary it is six or seven hundred paces wide and eight or nine zhang deep; west of Sannü Fortress it is three or four hundred paces wide and five or six zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: Near the estuary the channel is six or seven hundred paces wide and eight or nine zhang deep; west of Sannü Fortress it is three or four hundred paces wide and five or six zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 其勢愈深，其流愈猛，天所以限契丹。

translations.literal: The deeper the terrain, the fiercer the current — heaven's means of restraining the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: The deeper the channel, the swifter the current — heaven's own barrier against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 議者欲再開二股，漸閉北流，此乃未嘗睹黃河在界河內東流之利也。」

translations.literal: Those debating wish to reopen the Two-Branch channel and gradually close the northern flow — this shows they have never seen the benefit of the Yellow River flowing east within the border river."
translations.idiomatic: Advocates of reopening the Two-Branch channel and gradually shutting the northern flow have never grasped the advantage of the Yellow River running east inside the frontier channel."

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔翰林學士司馬光、入內內侍省副都知張茂則，乘傳相度四州生堤，回日兼視六塔、二股利害。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month an edict ordered Hanlin Academician Sima Guang and Inner Attendant Vice Director Zhang Maozhe to travel by post horse and survey the new dikes in the four prefectures; on their return they were also to examine the pros and cons of Liuta and the Two-Branch River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the court ordered Hanlin Academician Sima Guang and Inner Attendant Vice Director Zhang Maozhe to ride post horses and survey the new dikes in the four prefectures, and on their return to assess the Liuta and Two-Branch River projects as well.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，光入對：「請如宋昌言策，於二股之西置上約，擗水令東。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Guang entered audience and said: "I request following Song Changyan's plan — place an upper contract west of the Two-Branch channel and split the water eastward."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Sima Guang addressed the throne: "I urge adopting Song Changyan's plan: build an upper contract west of the Two-Branch channel and divert the water east."

sentences.zh: 俟東流漸深，北流淤淺，即塞北流，放出御河、胡盧河，下紓恩、冀、深、瀛以西之患。」

translations.literal: Wait until the eastern flow gradually deepens and the northern flow silts shallow, then block the northern flow, release the Imperial River and Hulu River, and relieve the calamity west of En, Ji, Shen, and Ying."
translations.idiomatic: Once the eastern channel deepens and the northern one silts up, block the northern flow, restore the Imperial River and Hulu River, and relieve flooding west of En, Ji, Shen, and Ying."

sentences.zh: 初，商胡決河自魏之北，至恩、冀、乾甯入於海，是謂北流。

translations.literal: Initially the Shanghu breach river ran from north of Wei to En, Ji, and Qianning into the sea — this was called the northern flow.
translations.idiomatic: After the Shanghu breach the river ran north of Wei through En, Ji, and Qianning to the sea — the northern flow.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐五年，河流派于魏之第六埽，遂為二股，自魏、恩東至於德、滄，入於海，是謂東流。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiayou the river branched at Wei's sixth bund and became two streams, running from Wei and En east to De and Cang into the sea — this was called the eastern flow.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiayou 5 the river split at the sixth bund in Wei prefecture into two channels running east from Wei and En through De and Cang to the sea — the eastern flow.

sentences.zh: 時議者多不同，李立之力主生堤，帝不聽，卒用昌言說，置上約。

translations.literal: At the time many in the debate disagreed; Li Lizhi strongly advocated the new dikes, but the emperor did not heed him and finally adopted Changyan's plan, establishing the upper contract.
translations.idiomatic: Opinion was sharply divided. Li Lizhi pressed hard for the new dikes, but the emperor rejected that course and finally adopted Song Changyan's plan, building the upper contract.

sentences.zh: 三月，光奏：「治河當因地形水勢，若強用人力，引使就高，橫立堤防，則逆激旁潰，不惟無成，仍敗舊績。

translations.literal: In the third month Guang memorialized: "River control should follow terrain and water force. If one forcibly uses human labor to draw the river to higher ground and erect dikes across its path, the backwash will burst the banks — not only will nothing be achieved, past accomplishments will also be ruined."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Sima Guang memorialized: "River control must follow the land and the water's own force. Forcing the river uphill and building dikes across its path will only drive the current sideways and burst the banks — ruining past work and achieving nothing."

sentences.zh: 臣慮官吏見東流已及四分，急於見功，遽塞北流。

translations.literal: Your subject fears that officials, seeing the eastern flow already at four-tenths, eager to show achievement, will hastily block the northern flow.
translations.idiomatic: I fear that officials, seeing the eastern channel already carrying four-tenths of the flow, will rush to claim credit and seal off the northern channel too soon.

sentences.zh: 而不知二股分流，十里之內，相去尚近，地勢復東高西下。

translations.literal: Yet they do not realize that with the two branches split, within ten li they are still close together, and the terrain again rises to the east and falls to the west.
translations.idiomatic: They do not see that the two branches, though split, lie within ten li of each other on ground that slopes down from east to west.

sentences.zh: 若河流並東，一遇盛漲，水勢西合入北流，則東流遂絕；

translations.literal: If the river's flow all goes east, once a great flood swell comes, the water force will merge westward into the northern flow and the eastern flow will then be cut off;
translations.idiomatic: If all the water is forced east, a major flood will drive the current back west into the northern channel and the eastern flow will die;

sentences.zh: 或於滄、德堤埽未成之處，決溢橫流。

translations.literal: or at places where the Cang and De dikes and bunds are not yet complete, it will breach and overflow in cross-flow.
translations.idiomatic: or it will burst where the Cang and De dikes and bunds are still unfinished and spill across the land.

sentences.zh: 雖除西路之患，而害及東路，非策也。

translations.literal: Though the calamity on the western route would be removed, harm would reach the eastern route — this is no plan.
translations.idiomatic: That would relieve the western route only to wreck the eastern one — a poor strategy.

sentences.zh: 宜專護上約及二股堤岸。

translations.literal: One should devote effort solely to protecting the upper contract and the Two-Branch dikes and banks.
translations.idiomatic: We should concentrate on protecting the upper contract and the Two-Branch dikes.

sentences.zh: 若今歲東流止添二分，則此去河勢自東，近者二三年，遠者四五年，候及八分以上，河流沖刷已闊，滄、德堤埽已固，自然北流日減，可以閉塞，兩路俱無害矣。」

translations.literal: If this year the eastern flow adds only two-tenths more, then from here the river's force will turn eastward of itself — in two or three years at the nearest, four or five at the farthest. When it reaches eight-tenths or more, the river's scouring will have widened the channel, the Cang and De dikes and bunds will be secure, the northern flow will naturally diminish day by day, and it can be closed off — both routes will then be harmless."
translations.idiomatic: If the eastern channel gains only two-tenths more this year, the river will gradually turn east on its own — in two or three years, perhaps four or five. Once it carries eight-tenths or more, the scoured channel will be wide, the Cang and De defenses solid, and the northern flow will shrink daily until it can safely be shut off, leaving both routes secure."

sentences.zh: 會北京留守韓琦言：「今歲兵夫數少，而金堤兩埽，修上、下約甚急，深進馬頭，欲奪大河。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Beijing Commandant Han Qi said: "This year corvee laborers are few, yet at the two Jin di bunds the upper and lower contracts are being repaired with great urgency, advancing the horse-head structures deeply to seize the Great River."
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Beijing Commandant Han Qi warned: "Labor is scarce this year, yet at the two Jin di bunds work on the upper and lower contracts is being rushed forward, with horse-head structures pushed deep into the channel to wrest control of the Great River."

sentences.zh: 緣二股及嫩灘舊闊千一百步，是以可容漲水。

translations.literal: Because the Two-Branch channel and the tender shoal were originally eleven hundred paces wide, they could hold flood swell.
translations.idiomatic: The Two-Branch channel and the tender shoal were once eleven hundred paces wide — wide enough to absorb flood swell.

sentences.zh: 今截去八百步有餘，則將束大河于二百余步之間，下流既壅，上流蹙遏湍怒，又無兵夫修護堤岸，其沖決必矣。

translations.literal: Now more than eight hundred paces have been cut off, which will confine the Great River within little more than two hundred paces. The lower reach will be blocked, the upper reach constricted and turbulent, and with no corvee laborers to repair and protect the dikes and banks, breach is inevitable.
translations.idiomatic: More than eight hundred paces have now been cut away, squeezing the Great River into little more than two hundred. The lower reach will choke, the upper reach will roar under the pressure, and with no labor to maintain the banks, a breach is certain.

sentences.zh: 況自德至滄，皆二股下流，既無堤防，必侵民田。

translations.literal: Moreover from De to Cang is all the lower reach of the Two-Branch channel; with no dikes in place, farmland will surely be inundated.
translations.idiomatic: From De to Cang the entire lower Two-Branch reach lacks dikes and will inevitably flood farmland.

sentences.zh: 設若河門束狹，不能容納漲水，上、下約隨流而脫，則二股與北流為一，其患愈大。

translations.literal: If the river mouth is constricted and cannot hold flood swell, and the upper and lower contracts wash away with the current, then the Two-Branch channel and the northern flow will become one — the calamity will be all the greater.
translations.idiomatic: If the river mouth is narrowed so it cannot hold flood swell and the upper and lower contracts are torn away, the Two-Branch channel and the northern flow will merge — and the disaster will be worse still.

sentences.zh: 又恩、深州所創生堤，其東則大河西來，其西則西山諸水東注，腹背受水，兩難捍禦。

translations.literal: Furthermore, the new dikes built in En and Shen prefectures have the Great River coming from the west on their east and the western hills' waters pouring east on their west — attacked on both front and rear by water, both sides are hard to defend.
translations.idiomatic: The new dikes in En and Shen prefectures face the Great River from the west on one side and mountain streams from the western hills on the other — caught between two floods, neither front can be held.

sentences.zh: 望選近臣速至河所，與在外官合議。

translations.literal: We hope a close minister will be chosen to hurry to the river site and confer jointly with the officials on the scene.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a senior court official be sent quickly to the river to confer with the local officers on the ground.

sentences.zh: 」帝在經筵以琦奏諭光，命同茂則再往。

translations.literal: " At the classics lecture the emperor relayed Qi's memorial to Guang and ordered him to go again together with Maozhe.
translations.idiomatic: " At the classics lecture the emperor shared Han Qi's memorial with Sima Guang and ordered him to return to the river with Zhang Maozhe.

sentences.zh: 四月，光與張鞏、李立之、宋昌言、張問、呂大防、程昉行視上約及方鋸牙，濟河，集議於下約。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Guang, together with Zhang Gong, Li Lizhi, Song Changyan, Zhang Wen, Lü Dafang, and Cheng Fang, inspected the upper contract and the square saw-teeth structures, crossed the river, and assembled for deliberation at the lower contract.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Sima Guang joined Zhang Gong, Li Lizhi, Song Changyan, Zhang Wen, Lü Dafang, and Cheng Fang to inspect the upper contract and the square saw-teeth structures, crossed the river, and met for deliberation at the lower contract.

sentences.zh: 光等奏：「二股河上約並在灘上，不礙河行。

translations.literal: Guang and the others memorialized: "The upper contracts on the Two-Branch channel are both on the shoal and do not impede the river's course."
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang and his colleagues reported: "The upper contracts on the Two-Branch channel sit on the shoal and do not obstruct the river's flow."

sentences.zh: 但所進方鋸牙已深，致北流河門稍狹，乞減折二十步，令近後，仍作蛾眉埽裹護。

translations.literal: But the square saw-teeth structures advanced are already too deep, making the northern-flow river mouth somewhat narrow. We request reducing them by twenty paces and setting them farther back, and still building crescent bunds for wrapping protection.
translations.idiomatic: But the square saw-teeth structures have been pushed too far forward, narrowing the northern channel's mouth. We ask that they be pulled back twenty paces and that crescent bunds be built for protection.

sentences.zh: 其滄、德界有古遙堤，當加葺治。

translations.literal: At the Cang and De border there is an ancient distant dike that should be repaired and maintained.
translations.idiomatic: An ancient distant dike on the Cang-De border should also be repaired.

sentences.zh: 所修二股，本欲疏導河水東去，生堤本欲捍御河水西來，相為表裏，未可偏廢。

translations.literal: The Two-Branch repairs were originally meant to guide river water eastward; the new dikes were originally meant to hold back river water coming from the west — they complement each other as inner and outer defenses and neither should be abandoned one-sidedly.
translations.idiomatic: The Two-Branch works were meant to steer the river east; the new dikes were meant to hold back floods from the west. They work as inner and outer defenses together, and neither should be dropped.

sentences.zh: 」帝因謂二府曰：「韓琦頗疑修二股。

translations.literal: " The emperor then said to the two councils: "Han Qi is quite doubtful about repairing the Two-Branch channel."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then told the two councils: "Han Qi has serious doubts about the Two-Branch repairs."

sentences.zh: 」趙抃曰：「人多以六塔為戒。

translations.literal: " Zhao Bian said: "Many people take Liuta as a warning."
translations.idiomatic: " Zhao Bian replied: "Many take Liuta as a cautionary tale."

sentences.zh: 」王安石曰：「異議者，皆不考事實故也。

translations.literal: " Wang Anshi said: "Those who dissent do so because they have not examined the facts."
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi said: "The dissenters simply have not looked at the facts."

sentences.zh: 」帝又問：「程昉、宋昌言同修二股如何？

translations.literal: " The emperor asked again: "How would it be for Cheng Fang and Song Changyan to jointly repair the Two-Branch channel?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "What if Cheng Fang and Song Changyan jointly oversee the Two-Branch repairs?"

sentences.zh: 」安石以為可治。

translations.literal: " Anshi considered it manageable.
translations.idiomatic: " Anshi said it could be done.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「欲作簽河甚善。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Wanting to undertake channel-piercing is very good."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Channel-piercing is an excellent idea."

sentences.zh: 」安石曰：「誠然。

translations.literal: " Anshi said: "Indeed so."
translations.idiomatic: " Anshi agreed: "Exactly."

sentences.zh: 若及時作之，使決河可東，北流可閉。

translations.literal: If done in timely fashion, the breach river can be made to go east and the northern flow can be closed.
translations.idiomatic: Done promptly, the breach channel can be turned east and the northern flow shut off.

sentences.zh: 」因言：「李立之所築生堤，去河遠者至八九十里，本計以禦漫水，而不可御河南之向著，臣恐漫水亦不可禦也。

translations.literal: " He went on to say: "The new dikes Li Lizhi built stand as far as eighty or ninety li from the river. They were originally planned to hold back spreading flood water, but they cannot hold back the river advancing from the south. Your subject fears that spreading flood water also cannot be held back."
translations.idiomatic: " He added: "Li Lizhi's new dikes stand as far as eighty or ninety li from the river. They were meant to block spreading floodwater, but they cannot stop the river itself advancing from the south — and I doubt they can even stop the spreading water."

sentences.zh: 」帝以為然。

translations.literal: " The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，乃詔立之乘驛赴闕議之。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the fifth month an edict ordered Lizhi to ride post horse to court to discuss the matter.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month the court ordered Li Lizhi to ride post to the capital for consultation.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，命司馬光都大提舉修二股工役。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the sixth month Sima Guang was appointed overall supervisor of the Two-Branch repair works.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the sixth month Sima Guang was appointed chief supervisor of the Two-Branch repair project.

sentences.zh: 呂公著言：「朝廷遣光相視董役，非所以褒崇近職、待遇儒臣也。

translations.literal: Lü Gongzhu said: "For the court to send Guang to inspect and supervise the works is not the way to honor close offices and treat Confucian ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gongzhu objected: "Sending Sima Guang to inspect and supervise river works is no way to honor a senior court officer or treat a Confucian minister."

sentences.zh: 」乃罷光行。

translations.literal: " Guang's mission was then cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: " Sima Guang's assignment was cancelled.

sentences.zh: 七月，二股河通快，北流稍自閉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Two-Branch River flowed freely and smoothly, and the northern flow somewhat closed of itself.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Two-Branch River ran clear and fast, and the northern channel began to close on its own.

sentences.zh: 戊子，張鞏奏：「上約累經泛漲，並下約各已無虞，東流勢漸順快，宜塞北流，除恩、冀、深、瀛、永靜、乾寧等州軍水患。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day Zhang Gong memorialized: "The upper contract has repeatedly survived flood swell, and the lower contract too is now secure. The eastern flow is gradually running smooth and fast. The northern flow should be blocked to remove the water calamity in En, Ji, Shen, Ying, Yongjing, Qianning, and other prefectures and armies."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Zhang Gong memorialized: "The upper contract has weathered repeated floods, and the lower contract is secure. The eastern channel is running smoothly. We should block the northern flow and end flooding in En, Ji, Shen, Ying, Yongjing, Qianning, and neighboring jurisdictions."

sentences.zh: 又使御河、胡盧河下流各還故道，則漕運無壅遏，郵傳無滯留，塘泊無淤淺。

translations.literal: Furthermore, if the lower reaches of the Imperial River and Hulu River each return to their old channels, then grain transport will not be blocked, courier posts will not be delayed, and pond-barriers will not silt shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring the Imperial River and Hulu River to their old courses would unblock grain transport, keep the courier network moving, and prevent the pond-barriers from silting up.

sentences.zh: 復於邊防大計，不失南北之限，歲減費不可勝數，亦使流移歸復，實無窮之利。

translations.literal: It would also serve the great frontier plan by preserving the north-south boundary, save incalculable yearly expense, and allow displaced people to return — truly endless benefit.
translations.idiomatic: It would serve frontier strategy by preserving the north-south boundary, save untold annual expense, and let displaced people return home — benefits without end.

sentences.zh: 且黃河所至，古今未嘗無患，較利害輕重而取捨之可也。

translations.literal: Moreover, wherever the Yellow River reaches, calamity has never been absent in past or present — one may compare the lighter and heavier of benefits and harms and choose accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River has brought trouble wherever it runs, in every age. We need only weigh the costs and benefits and choose accordingly.

sentences.zh: 惟是東流南北堤防未立，閉口修堤，工費甚夥，所當預備。

translations.literal: Only the north-south dikes for the eastern flow are not yet built; closing the mouth and building dikes will require very great labor costs, which should be prepared for in advance.
translations.idiomatic: But the north-south dikes for the eastern channel are not yet in place, and sealing the mouth and building dikes will be enormously costly — preparations must be made now.

sentences.zh: 望選習知河事者，與臣等講求，具圖以聞。

translations.literal: We hope those skilled and knowledgeable in river affairs will be selected to study the matter together with us and submit a diagram for report.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that experts in river works be chosen to study the plan with us and submit drawings for the court's review.

sentences.zh: 」乃復詔光、茂則及都水監官、河北轉運使同相度閉塞北流利害，有所不同，各以議上。

translations.literal: " An edict was again issued ordering Guang, Maozhe, Directorate of Waterways officials, and the Hebei transport commissioner jointly to survey the benefits and harms of blocking the northern flow; where views differed, each was to submit his opinion.
translations.idiomatic: " The court again ordered Sima Guang, Zhang Maozhe, Directorate officials, and the Hebei transport commissioner to assess the pros and cons of blocking the northern flow; where they disagreed, each was to submit his own view.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，光入辭，言：「鞏等欲塞二股河北流，臣恐勞費未易。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the eighth month Guang entered a farewell audience and said: "Zhang Gong and the others wish to block the northern flow of the Two-Branch channel. Your subject fears the labor and expense will not be easy."
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the eighth month Sima Guang took leave of the throne and said: "Zhang Gong and his allies want to shut the northern channel of the Two-Branch River. I fear the labor and expense will be formidable."

sentences.zh: 或幸而可塞，則東流淺狹，堤防未全，必致決溢，是移恩、冀、深、瀛之患於滄、德等州也。

translations.literal: If by good fortune it can be blocked, the eastern flow is shallow and narrow and the dikes are not complete — breach and overflow are inevitable. This would shift the calamity of En, Ji, Shen, and Ying onto Cang, De, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Even if sealing it succeeds, the eastern channel is still shallow and narrow and the dikes incomplete — a breach is inevitable. We would simply move the disaster from En, Ji, Shen, and Ying to Cang, De, and beyond.

sentences.zh: 不若俟三二年，東流益深闊，堤防稍固，北流漸淺，薪芻有備，塞之便。

translations.literal: Better to wait two or three years until the eastern flow grows deeper and wider, the dikes somewhat secure, the northern flow gradually shallow, and fuel and fodder prepared — then blocking will be convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Better to wait two or three years until the eastern channel deepens and widens, the dikes are stronger, the northern flow silts up, and supplies are ready — then sealing it will be straightforward.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「東流、北流之患孰輕重？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Which calamity is lighter and which heavier — the eastern flow or the northern flow?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "Which is the greater disaster — the eastern flow or the northern?"

sentences.zh: 」光曰：「兩地皆王民，無輕重；

translations.literal: " Guang said: "Both regions are the emperor's people — there is no lighter or heavier;"
translations.idiomatic: " Sima Guang replied: "Both regions hold the emperor's people — neither can be ranked above the other;"

sentences.zh: 然北流已殘破，東流尚全。

translations.literal: yet the northern flow is already ravaged and broken, while the eastern flow is still intact.
translations.idiomatic: but the northern channel is already devastated while the eastern one remains intact.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰；

translations.literal: " The emperor said:
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said:

sentences.zh: 「今不俟東流順快而塞北流，他日河勢改移，奈何？

translations.literal: "Now, not waiting for the eastern flow to run smooth and fast before blocking the northern flow — if the river's force shifts someday, what then?"
translations.idiomatic: "If we block the northern flow before the eastern channel runs clear, what happens when the river shifts course someday?"

sentences.zh: 」光曰：「上約固則東流日增，北流日減，何憂改移。

translations.literal: " Guang said: "If the upper contract holds firm, the eastern flow will increase day by day and the northern flow decrease day by day — why worry about a shift?"
translations.idiomatic: " Sima Guang replied: "If the upper contract holds, the eastern flow will grow daily and the northern shrink — why fear a shift?"

sentences.zh: 若上約流失，其事不可知，惟當並力護上約耳。

translations.literal: If the upper contract is lost, the outcome cannot be known — one can only join forces to protect the upper contract.
translations.idiomatic: If the upper contract fails, anything could happen — our only course is to defend it with all our strength.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「上約安可保？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "How can the upper contract be guaranteed?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "How can the upper contract be kept secure?"

sentences.zh: 」光曰：「今歲創修，誠為難保，然昨經大水而無虞，來歲地腳已牢，復何慮。

translations.literal: " Guang said: "Built anew this year, it is truly hard to guarantee — yet it just passed through great flood without trouble. Next year its foundations will be firm; what further worry is there?"
