translations.idiomatic: " Sima Guang said: "Freshly built this year, it is hard to guarantee — yet it just survived a major flood unscathed. Next year its foundations will be set; what is there to fear?"

sentences.zh: 且上約居河之側，聽河北流，猶懼不保；

translations.literal: Moreover the upper contract sits beside the river and allows the northern flow to pass — even so we still fear it cannot be held;
translations.idiomatic: The upper contract sits beside the river and still lets the northern flow pass — and even that we can barely hold;

sentences.zh: 今欲橫截使不行，庸可保乎？

translations.literal: now you wish to block it crosswise so it cannot flow — how can that be guaranteed?
translations.idiomatic: and now you want to block the river entirely — how can that be secure?

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「若河水常分二流，何時當有成功？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "If the river water is always split in two flows, when will there be success?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "If the river stays divided in two, when will the project ever succeed?"

sentences.zh: 」光曰：「上約苟存，東流必增，北流必減；

translations.literal: " Guang said: "If the upper contract survives, the eastern flow must increase and the northern flow must decrease;"
translations.idiomatic: " Sima Guang replied: "As long as the upper contract holds, the eastern flow will grow and the northern shrink;"

sentences.zh: 借使分為二流，于張鞏等不見成功，於國家亦無所害。

translations.literal: Even supposing it remains split in two flows — Zhang Gong and the others may see no success, but the state will suffer no harm.
translations.idiomatic: Even if the river stays divided, Zhang Gong and his allies may see no victory — but the state would come to no harm.

sentences.zh: 何則？

translations.literal: Why is this so?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 西北之水，並于山東，故為害大，分則害小矣。

translations.literal: The waters of the northwest all converge on Shandong — therefore the harm is great; divided, the harm is small.
translations.idiomatic: All the waters of the northwest converge on Shandong, so the damage is greatest when they run together — divided, the harm is far less.

sentences.zh: 鞏等亟欲塞北流，皆為身謀，不顧國力與民患也。

translations.literal: Zhang Gong and the others urgently wish to block the northern flow — all for their own advancement, heedless of state strength and the people's calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gong and his allies are rushing to seal the northern flow for their own credit, without regard for the state's resources or the people's suffering.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「防捍兩河，何以供億？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Defending both rivers — how can the supplies be provided?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked: "If we must defend both channels, how can we afford it?"

sentences.zh: 」光曰：「並為一則勞費自倍，分二流則勞費減半。

translations.literal: " Guang said: "Uniting them as one doubles labor and expense of itself; dividing into two flows halves labor and expense."
translations.idiomatic: " Sima Guang replied: "Merging them into one channel doubles the cost; keeping two channels cuts it in half."

sentences.zh: 今減北流財力之半，以備東流，不亦可乎？

translations.literal: Now reduce by half the resources devoted to the northern flow and use them to prepare for the eastern flow — is that not acceptable?
translations.idiomatic: Shift half the resources now spent on the northern channel to the eastern one — would that not suffice?

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「卿等至彼視之。」

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "You shall go there and inspect it yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Go there and see for yourselves."

sentences.zh: 時二股河東流及六分，鞏等因欲閉斷北流，帝意向之。

translations.literal: At that time the eastern flow of the Two-Branch River had reached six-tenths; Zhang Gong and others therefore wished to close off the northern flow, and the emperor's inclination favored it.
translations.idiomatic: By then the eastern branch of the Two-Branch River carried six-tenths of the current. Zhang Gong and his allies pressed to seal the northern flow, and the emperor was inclined to agree.

sentences.zh: 光以為須及八分乃可，仍待其自然，不可施功。

translations.literal: Guang held that it must reach eight-tenths before it would do, and one should still await nature's course — force could not be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang argued that eight-tenths was needed before sealing would work, and that nature must take its course — no forced engineering yet.

sentences.zh: 王安石曰：「光議事屢不合，今令視河，後必不從其議，是重使不安職也。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "Guang's counsel repeatedly fails to accord with policy. Now ordering him to survey the river when later his advice will surely not be followed — this is to make a weighty appointment one in which he cannot perform his duty with peace of mind."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said: "Sima Guang's advice repeatedly clashes with policy. Sending him to survey the river when his recommendations will surely be ignored only sets him up to fail in a weighty post."

sentences.zh: 」庚子，乃獨遣茂則。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Maozhe alone was dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day only Maozhe was sent.

sentences.zh: 茂則奏：「二股河東傾已及八分，北流止二分。

translations.literal: Maozhe reported: "The Two-Branch River's eastern inclination has already reached eight-tenths; the northern flow is only two-tenths."
translations.idiomatic: Maozhe reported: "The eastern branch now carries eight-tenths of the current; the northern flow only two-tenths."

sentences.zh: 」張鞏等亦奏：「丙午，大河東徙，北流淺小。

translations.literal: Zhang Gong and others also reported: "On the bingwu day the great river shifted east; the northern flow is shallow and small."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gong and others also reported: "On the bingwu day the main river shifted eastward; the northern channel is shallow and weak."

sentences.zh: 戊申，北流閉。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, the northern flow was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day the northern channel was sealed.

sentences.zh: 」詔獎諭司馬光等，仍賜衣、帶、馬。

translations.literal: An edict commended and instructed Sima Guang and others, and additionally bestowed robes, belts, and horses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended Sima Guang and his colleagues and bestowed robes, belts, and horses.

sentences.zh: 時北流既塞，而河自其南四十里許家港東決，氾濫大名、恩、德、滄、永靜五州軍境。

translations.literal: At that time, though the northern flow had been blocked, the river breached eastward at Xujia Harbor forty li to its south, inundating the territory of the five prefectures and armies of Daming, En, De, Cang, and Yongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Though the northern channel was sealed, the river broke east at Xujia Harbor forty li to the south, flooding Daming, En, De, Cang, and Yongjing.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，命茂則、鞏相度澶、滑州以下至東流河勢、堤防利害。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Maozhe and Gong were ordered to survey from Chan and Hua prefectures downstream to the eastern flow — the river's force and the advantages and harms of the dikes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year Maozhe and Zhang Gong were ordered to survey from Chan and Hua downstream along the eastern channel, assessing water conditions and dike defenses.

sentences.zh: 時方濬御河，韓琦言：「事有緩急，工有後先，今御河漕運通駛，未至有害，不宜減大河之役。

translations.literal: At that time the Imperial Canal was being dredged; Han Qi said: "Affairs have urgency and ease, and works have priority and sequence. Now the Imperial Canal's transport grain runs clear and fast and has not yet become harmful — it is not fitting to reduce labor on the great river."
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Canal was being dredged at the time. Han Qi said: "Tasks have priorities. The canal transport is running smoothly and poses no threat yet — we should not cut back work on the Yellow River."

sentences.zh: 」乃詔輟河夫卒三萬三千，專治東流。

translations.literal: An edict then halted thirty-three thousand river laborers and soldiers, dedicating them solely to managing the eastern flow.
translations.idiomatic: An edict redirected thirty-three thousand river workers to focus exclusively on the eastern channel.
